task.topic: Among human randomized controlled trials, what treatment-emergent adverse effects are associated with omega-3 PUFA supplementation compared with placebo or standard treatment?

pico.population: Human participants enrolled in randomized controlled trials
pico.exposure: Supplemental long-chain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids
pico.comparator: Placebo, control oil, or source-defined standard-treatment comparator
outcomes: Participants with at least one treatment-emergent diarrhea adverse event

outcome.description: Participants with at least one treatment-emergent diarrhea adverse event

targets.effect_selection_rule: Extract exact participant-level arm counts for each independent randomized comparison. Preserve exact but nonpoolable crossover, withdrawal-only, and overlapping-subgroup records so the downstream analysis task can reject them.

field_definitions.intervention_events: Participants in eligible omega-3 arms with at least one diarrhea event.
field_definitions.intervention_total: Participants in eligible omega-3 safety arms.
field_definitions.control_events: Participants in the randomized comparator arm with at least one diarrhea event.
field_definitions.control_total: Participants in the randomized comparator safety arm.
field_definitions.outcome_unit: Must distinguish participants, events, and withdrawals.

allowed_source_derivations: sum exact events and totals across mutually exclusive eligible intervention arms sharing one comparator
derive odds ratio and 95% confidence interval from exact arm counts
derivation_preconditions: all component arms are randomized and mutually exclusive
the comparator is not counted more than once
the source reports participant-level rather than event-level counts
derivation_instructions: For an eligible multi-dose treatment class, sum intervention events and totals before calculating one odds ratio.
For a zero cell, add 0.5 to all four cells for that comparison only.
source_aggregation_rules: Keep independent trials in one paper separate.
For a factorial trial, collapse strata to one prespecified treatment main-effect comparison when all strata are mutually exclusive.
Do not pool a crossover record without paired event information.

extraction_notes: Loose stools alone are not diarrhea unless the source maps them to the same outcome.
Composite gastrointestinal outcomes remain source-only findings.
No target-review forest values may be used to fill missing primary-source numbers.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Extract exact participant-level arm counts for each independent randomized comparison. Preserve exact but nonpoolable crossover, withdrawal-only, and overlapping-subgroup records so the downstream analysis task can reject them.
extraction.exclusion_concepts: Loose stools alone are not diarrhea unless the source maps them to the same outcome. Composite gastrointestinal outcomes remain source-only findings. No target-review forest values may be used to fill missing primary-source numbers.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Every extracted record must retain exact source evidence, page, source-defined effect scale, exposure unit, adjustment set, and missingness.
